meta: How to ask AI in Vietnamese so it gets it right the first time: always type tone marks, say you're in Vietnam, and tell it how to address people.
prompt: Answer in Vietnamese, in a Vietnamese context, and use polite forms of address.

muc.title: Typing without tone marks
muc.text: Type Vietnamese without tone marks, and AI misunderstands more easily than you think.

muc.title: Always type the tone marks
muc.text: The word ban without tone marks could mean table, sell, friend or busy. Type all the marks and AI doesn't have to guess.

muc.title: Say you're in Vietnam
muc.text: Say clearly that you're in Vietnam, so AI uses the right currency, laws and units, instead of assuming you're in the US.

muc.title: Say how to address people
muc.text: When writing to your boss or messaging a customer, say which form of address to use, like the polite words for older people or valued customers, so the writing sounds natural.

muc.title: A standing instruction
muc.text: Save this in your chatbot's custom instructions: answer in Vietnamese, in a Vietnamese context, and use polite forms of address.
